title: Legal — clear registered reference: leaking bath waste (installation for sanitation)
why: An observed leak from the bath waste with damp to the floor and ceiling below is disrepair to an installation for sanitation — squarely s.11. The register entry must be selected; S9A/S10 may accompany it.

room.name: Bathroom
room.note: Bath waste trap dripping steadily when the bath is emptied — watched it. Floorboards under the bath wet and soft, 62% WME. Stain to kitchen ceiling below.

transcripts: Bathroom, pulled the bath panel, ran the bath and let it out, trap's dripping steadily onto the boards. Boards are wet and soft, sixty two percent. There's a stain on the kitchen ceiling directly under.

must_not_happen.label: an observed running leak is not condensation
no duty-of-care citation without a risk-to-person basis

allowed_uncertainty: High confidence is defensible: the leak was observed in action.
reviewer_notes: The 'expected legal_includes' line carries the positive check; leaving the list empty here fails that line as a major.
